sources.observation: The smallest of the main Giza pyramids has the retained lower granite courses, exposed rough limestone above and the tall scar in its north slope.
The same mapped identity is present in the polygon and points-of-interest layers.

limitations: The PMTiles plan and reference photo control the major shapes. Course positions, casing losses and individual masonry blocks are authored estimates.
The base elevation and footing contact are approximate and depend on the host terrain source.
The three queens’ pyramids and their temples remain separate mapped structures.
